items.title: 'Sold-out King' BTS Jin: Gucci Campaign Jacket to Chicago Concert Merch, Sold Out Again
items.summary: Coverage ties Jin's sold-out concert merch to the Gucci Primavera campaign leather jacket ($9,900) that reportedly sold out within 24 hours of the campaign's Aug 25 release; notes Jin topped global Google Trends for Gucci-related searches and trended on X across multiple countries, framed as a commercial win for the brand's ambassador strategy.

items.title: BTS Member Gets Brutally Trolled Over New Look
items.summary: Reports online backlash against Jin's edgier Gucci Primavera styling (grey biker jacket, dark denim, heavy eyeliner), with commenters saying he 'couldn't carry the style well' and mocking the look as 'emo'; illustrates a critical countercurrent to the otherwise celebratory campaign coverage.

items.title: theqoo: BTS Jin x Gucci Primavera campaign photoshoot reactions
items.summary: Korean fan-community thread shows split reactions to Jin's Primavera photos: several commenters called the smokey-eye makeup 'kinda bad' and posing 'super awkward,' while others read it as a nostalgic callback to BTS's debut-era styling or praised the experimental concept.

items.title: 金硕珍粉丝非法曝光肖战身份证信息，工作室已起诉
items.summary: A subset of Jin (BTS) fans, angered that Xiao Zhan received the WWD cover placement in Gucci's campaign while Jin appeared on an inside page, illegally posted Xiao Zhan's ID card details on Xiaohongshu; Xiao Zhan's studio filed suit Aug 27 seeking platform disclosure of the users' identities, extending Gucci's campaign into an unwanted fandom-conflict controversy.

items.title: 金硕珍与肖战 Gucci 待遇对比投票
items.summary: Weibo hot-topic threads comparing perceived unequal ad placement between Jin and Xiao Zhan in the Gucci Primavera campaign continue to circulate, with cross-fandom 'who got better treatment' vote threads keeping the controversy active on Chinese social media several days after the campaign dropped.

items.title: Kering stock steadies as Gucci reset supports earnings recovery
items.summary: Financial analysis of Kering's Q2 2026 results notes Gucci revenue fell 2% YoY, an improvement from a 5% H1 decline; jewelry (+18%) and eyewear (+8%) outperformed. Management plans to cut Fashion and Leather Goods inventory by EUR1bn by December 2026, and analysts frame Gucci's recovery as gradual and still fragile relative to stronger-performing divisions.

items.title: 中共税收冲击下 中国奢侈品销售大幅下滑
items.summary: Reports China's top 25 luxury brands saw July sales drop over 10% as Beijing's crackdown on offshore wealth and back-tax enforcement combined with an 8.9% YTD MSCI China decline to curb affluent spending; Gucci is named among brands posting double-digit declines, with an interviewed Shanghai finance professional describing abandoning non-essential luxury purchases after portfolio losses.

items.title: グッチ新作「ジャッキー フラップ」セレブリティ愛用SNAP
items.summary: Roundup of Instagram snaps showing celebrities and vintage-Gucci-focused influencers, including tennis player Oda Kintaro, adopting the new Jackie Flap bag, framed as reviving interest in the archival Jackie line among younger Japanese audiences.

items.title: What happened between BTS' Jin and Xiao Zhan fans? Gucci comparisons escalate after alleged doxxing
items.summary: Explainer recapping the Aug 25-27 timeline of the Gucci Primavera ambassador-treatment dispute: fan comparisons of Jin's and Xiao Zhan's campaign placement escalated into a doxxing incident, Xiao Zhan's studio pursuing legal action via Weibo/Xiaohongshu evidence preservation, and Jin's Chinese fanclub issuing an apology statement to Xiao Zhan, with some fans disputing the doxxing account's true affiliation.
